summary: Feature implemented in the repository, not executed. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), with plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Rewrote the SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler handlers as thin adapters that make one delegating call each. Changed the write_nifti default dtype to np.float32. Renamed output_path to output_dir in the three in-repo callers (two examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py). Updated tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename, and added tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Tests were not run, per instructions, and nothing was committed. Choices to review: a plain dict is used for the CSV cache, the plot tests check tags and call counts by mocking add_image, and no TensorBoard index test was added beyond the plot function tests.
